fields.image: |multiimage=|imagetext=|jname=|rname=|ename=|prev anime=|next anime=}} {{For|other uses|Dream (Disambiguation)}} The '''Ocean's Dream Arc''' is the sixth [[filler]] arc in the [[One Piece (Anime)|''One Piece'' anime]]. It is loosely adapted from—and named for—the 2003 video game ''[[Ocean's Dream! - Oceans of Dreams|Ocean's Dream]]''.  ==Summary== {{Spoiler}} One night while docked near an island, all of the crew starts to fall asleep, with only [[Nico Robin|Robin]] staying up reading a book, and a young man blows into a seahorse-shaped instruments underwater. That morning, Robin greets a waking [[Nami]] only to find that she cannot recognize her. In the boys' bedroom, [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] was the first to wake and ran away when he saw that he was surrounded by humans. When the other men wake up, they all try to figure out what is going on since they have no idea how they got there or who everyone is, with the last things they remember is events right before [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] arrived in their lives (In Luffy's case, before he found himself on [[Alvida]]'s ship), and [[Usopp]] tells them that they are all part of his crew and lost their memory in a storm fighting a giant whale. However, [[Sanji]] quickly sees through this lie. He decides to make breakfast for everyone so they head up to the deck, and when Robin comes up with Nami to say that Nami lost her memory, Sanji falls in love all over again. They soon see Chopper hiding behind a barrel, having no idea what he is, so Luffy starts chasing after him. Robin says that they are on a pirate ship and everyone freaks out, especially Nami who still hates pirates without her memories of the crew. At this point, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] jumps down from the crow's nest and Usopp freaks out when he realizes that he is the infamous [[bounty hunter]]. Nami had gone back into her room and found a picture of her, [[Bell-mère]] and [[Nojiko]], and rushes off the ship using the Waver while bringing along the picture

Ace]].{{Qref|name=Family|chap=550|page=16-19|ep=459|Sengoku reveals the identities of Roger's lover and son.}}  Roger was the first pirate in history since [[Joy Boy]] to circumnavigate the [[Grand Line]], culminating in reaching its final island which he named [[Laugh Tale]]. Though the [[World Government]] staged the execution as a public spectacle to discourage piracy, Roger used his final words to ensure the opposite, openly declaring that the One Piece belonged to anyone that could find it. He is also the main antagonist of the [[Diary of Koby-Meppo]] cover-page serial.  ==Appearance== Morgan is a notably towering, muscular man with tanned skin, blonde hair, a well-defined face, and a steel jaw etched with the word '''''Möwe''''' (German for "seagull").{{Qref|sbs=5|page=168|Fan Question: What does the "Möwe" written on Morgan's chin mean?}} As his [[epithet]] suggests, his right hand has been replaced with a huge steel axe, the handle of which is not only bolted through the bones of his forearm, but sticks out where his elbow should be.  Like most Marine officers, he wears a large, ornate overcoat. However, this coat notably lacks the usual {{Nihongo|"Justice"|正義}} insignia, and is completely sleeveless; it is also worn conventionally, instead of being draped over the shoulders like a cape. His trousers bear a striped pattern reminiscent of [[Marine Base]]s and [[Marine Ships|battleships]].{{Qref|name=intro}}  In peacetime, he can often be seen smoking a cigar.  As a no-name Marine, Morgan had a cleft chin similar to his son’s (though this apparently developed after his youth), and his arms were both whole and a little less muscular, though he still seemed very well-built. During the attack by [[Kuro|Captain Kuro]], his arm was maimed and his chin shattered, necessitating his future prosthetics. fields.funi eva: {{W|Stephanie Young}}}}  {{For|the chapter of the same name|Chapter 393}}  '''Nico Olvia''' was an [[archaeologist]] from [[Ohara]] who studied the [[Poneglyph]]s two decades ago,{{Qref|name=intro}} the mother of [[Nico Robin]],{{Qref|name=wanted poster}} and the older sister of [[Oran]] and paternal aunt of [[Mizuira]].{{Qref|name=c393p14|chap=393|page=14|ep=276}}  While sailing with a group of fellow archaeologists, Olvia was captured by the [[Marines]] for conducting forbidden research. With the help of [[Jaguar D. Saul]], she was able to return to Ohara and briefly reunite with her daughter, but soon perished in the [[Buster Call]] alongside the other archaeologists.{{Qref|name=death|chap=398|page=2|ep=278}}  ==Appearance== Nico Olvia resembled her daughter (before timeskip appearance) in many ways: they shared almost identical facial and physical features, and had identically shaped and colored eyes (brown in the manga and blue in the anime). However, Olvia's hair was white instead of black. Her hair was also longer and slightly curly, and in the anime, she had a lighter tan skin tone.{{Qref|name=wanted poster}} When she departed from Ohara in order to find the Rio Poneglyph, she had shorter hair.{{Qref|name=c393p14|chap=393|page=14|ep=276}}  When she returned from her prison, she sported a completely different attire, consisting of a fur-lined coat over a light blue T-shirt which is slightly too short for her, exposing her bare midriff and belly button and long green trousers. Around her waist, she had a belt decorated by many golden disk-like ornaments. A modest necklace with a thin rope and three little pearls on it circled her neck.{{Qref|name=intro}}  {{gallery|position=center|captionalign=center|height=105|width=105

fields.page: 19}}  '''Chapter 429''' is titled "Utter Defeat".  ==Cover Page== [[Enel's Great Space Operations]], Vol. 2: "Upon the Fairy Vearth".  [[Enel]] steps forth onto his [[Moon|Promised Land]], and finds nothing but barren rock in every direction.  ==Short Summary== The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] get away on the [[Going Merry]].  ==Long Summary== The [[Marines]] are surprised that the [[Going Merry]] got past their warships without being seen. Everyone lands in the water. [[Kokoro]] tosses [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Nico Robin|Robin]], and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] onto the deck. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] tells [[Nami]] to give them orders. Luffy tries to thank Robin for saving him from the attack, but she sprouts a hand to cover his mouth and just smiles. She then stands up and thanks everyone for saving her. Zoro tells her to thank them once they get out of there, prompting [[Sanji]] to kick him, but is blocked. Nami breaks up the fight by telling Sanji to steer the ship. [[Spandam]] gives the order to take out Robin with the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], lying to the Marines the order came from [[Admiral]] [[Kuzan|Aokiji]]. The Marines try to fire at the Going Merry, but somehow accidentally hit another one of their own ship. They then realize that the [[Gates of Justice]] are closing without them noticing.  The whirlpools created by the gates closing are overriding the Marines' steering, causing their aim to be off. [[Usopp]] is about to ask Sanji if he was behind the gates closing, but Sanji simply tells him this was not the kind of enemy they could simply beat in a fight. They have to outsmart them as well. Zoro then points out that the whirlpools are dangerous for them too. Nami assures them that Merry can cross anything as long as they are on it. A ship right behind them fires at the Going Merry. fields.page: 19}}  '''Chapter 428''' is titled "Let's Go Back".  ==Cover Page== [[Enel's Great Space Operations]], Vol. 1: "Toward the Fairy Vearth".  In the cold depths of outer space, [[Ark Maxim|a certain flying ark]] approaches [[Moon|the so-called Fairy Vearth]].  ==Short Summary== The assault of the [[Buster Call]] on [[Enies Lobby]] continues. The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are backed into a corner and have to jump into the ocean.  ==Long Summary== Everyone is shocked by [[Rob Lucci]]'s defeat. One of the [[Marines]] calls him the strongest [[CP9]] leader in the history of [[Cipher Pol]]. [[Nami]] orders everyone to get on the escape ship. One of the Marines on one of the ships asks a subordinate where a certain noise is coming from. He concludes it is coming from a [[Den Den Mushi]]. The voice is from [[Zambai]] of the [[Franky Family]]. [[Vice Admiral]] [[Strawberry]] asks if the [[pirates]] at the main gate were defeated. A soldier reports that he saw them fall into the ravine below the island.  Thanks to some quick work, [[Paulie]] had been able to fashion two nets together out of the rope he had with him, which everyone was holding onto. [[Kokoro]] and [[Gonbe]] are happy to hear everyone is ok. [[Franky]] tearfully tells them he wasn't worried about them. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] tells Franky that his relief would not matter if he died. [[Onigumo]] orders that the pirates at the gate be left for now. Franky blocks and attack from [[Sharinguru]]. A Marine is heard reporting that Luffy is wounded and not moving.  [[Usopp]] is urging Luffy to get up. Stretch over to the ship and Usopp would carry him from there. Luffy tells him his body will not move. [[Nami]] tells Usopp they can take the ship to Luffy. Right after she says that, the ship is blown up with Kokoro, Chimney, and Chopper still on board. fields.page: 19}}  '''Chapter 424''' is titled "Escape Ship".  ==Cover Page== [[Where They Are Now]], Shot 1: "[[Conis]], [[Aisa]], [[Raki]] and [[Nola]] Take A Walk On [[Vearth]]."  With [[Upper Yard]] now open to all, [[Shandia]] and [[Skypiea]]ns alike have grown peaceable enough to hold picnics on it—with one another, and with the once-dreaded "Master of the Sky".  ==Short Summary== [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Rob Lucci]] continue their fight despite the destruction of [[Enies Lobby]].  ==Long Summary== [[Franky]] and [[Nico Robin|Robin]] secure the transport [[ship]] for their escape. [[Kokoro]] then bursts out of the water, yelling for people not to die. The [[Franky Family]], [[Galley-La]] foremen, and the [[giants]] reach the main gate. They then stop in their tracks when they see that war ships have already arrived. The [[Marines]] are boarding the ship, but are ordered by the [[vice admiral]] in command to identify their unit, quarter, Marine code, and have a photo ID. All the soldiers are grateful to not die. The ships' cannons, as well as all the guns on board, are being pointed at the escaping pirate collaborators. After securing the Marines, the ships pull back from the shore and start bombarding the island.  Back at the ship by the bridge, [[Nami]], [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Sanji]], [[Usopp]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Chimney]], and [[Gonbe]] are all on the deck in a state of shock. Kokoro called the state near-death and wondered what caused it. Franky tells Kokoro it was her. Zoro, Usopp, and Sanji regain consciousness. After seeing Kokoro again, Zoro believes the legend of dugongs being mistaken for [[mermaids]] to be true. Usopp does not believe that mermaids have legs. Sanji is in denial about the whole thing. Kokoro explained that mermaids' tail fins split in two when they turn 30, allowing them to live on land. She tells them they will see it once they reach [[Fish-Man Island]]. Chopper wakes up. fields.page: 18}}  '''Chapter 64''' is titled "The Mighty Battle Spear".  ==Cover Page== [[Cover Page#Color Covers|Color Cover]]: [[Sanji]] cooks away as head [[Cook|chef]] of the [[Baratie]], while kitchen assistant [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] feeds his alligator coworker.  ==Short Summary== [[Krieg|Don Krieg]] brandishes his strongest weapon, the [[Krieg#Weapons|Great Battle Spear]], which he uses to seemingly dominate [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. However, Luffy manages to break the tip of it.  ==Long Summary== [[Krieg|Don Krieg]] is knocked down once again by [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. This creates severe anguish amongst his [[Krieg Pirates|crew members]], as Don Krieg has always gone out of a battle unscathed. However, when one crewmate states that he believes Luffy to actually be stronger than Krieg, he arises, telling them to shut up before combining his shoulder plates together to form his "[[Krieg#Weapons|Great Battle Spear]]", which he slams into the ground next to Luffy, creating an explosion.  The crew members are finally rejoicing as they see Krieg's secret weapon, as he discards his cape and comments that it's way stronger than the stakes he fired at Luffy earlier. '''Su''' is a Cloud Fox and pet of [[Conis]].{{qref|name=debut}}  ==Appearance== [[File:Su Color Scheme.png|left|thumb|200px|Su's color scheme in the manga.]]  Su is solid white (pale purple in the anime) with squinted eyes and average-sized ears. Her mouth somewhat resembles a snout and has never been shown open. Her tail is long compared to her body, and is lighter at the end.{{qref|name=debut}}  {{-}}  ==Personality== Su is fairly intelligent, as she can understand Pagaya's commands{{qref|name=c269|chap=269|page=2-3|ep=176}} and can explain things through gestures and mimics.{{qref|name=c272|chap=272|page=10|ep=178}}{{qref|name=gestures|chap=283|page=4|ep=184|Su reports to Conis about Sanji and Usopp.}} Su is seen acting in an adorable way with Conis and Pagaya.  Su seems to like pumpkin juice, as she drank some that was left unattended by Pagaya.{{qref|name=c248|chap=248|page=2-8|ep=162}} She also seems able to sleep in loud situations, as she slept through Pagaya and Conis' meeting with Nami and wasn't disturbed by Pagaya's loud music. Her body resembles a fox-like creature{{qref|name=c264|chap=264|page=2, 5|ep=173}}  ==Relationships== ===Conis=== Su seems to love Conis{{qref|name=debut}}, as she is frequently seen in her arms or by her side. fields.page: 19}}  '''Chapter 412''' is titled "You Missed Your Chance".  ==Cover Page== [[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Vol. 41: "Mr. 0, 1, 2, 3."  The [[Marines]] haven't been left empty-handed—though the lower members of [[Baroque Works]] have escaped, [[Crocodile]] and [[Daz Bonez|Mr. 1]] remain in custody, and [[Hina]] has apprehended [[Bentham|Mr. 2]] ''and'' [[Galdino|Mr. 3]].  ==Short Summary== [[Nami]] defeats [[Kalifa]]. [[Franky]] sends [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] into the ocean to get him back to normal and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Usopp]] finally get their cuffs off.  ==Long Summary== [[Kalifa]], fried from [[Nami]]'s attack, falls to her knees. Nami tells her that her "forecast" shows that Kalifa will be defeated by her next attack. Kalifa uses [[Soru]] to get behind Nami and kicks her, but she is a mirage. She attacks three more mirages to no avail. Nami is making a storm cloud on her [[Clima-Tact]], saying the air currents from it will cause lightning to strike her heart. Kalifa reminds her that she was able to avoid being shocked before. Nami pointed out the weakness of her shield being that she cannot move. Kalifa then uses Soap Sheep, and attacks Nami with Hitsuji Gumo Tidal Wave.  Nami uses Cyclone Tempo to make an opening in the wave. She attacks a mirage. She then attacks the real Nami with Shigan. Nami then tells Kalifa that the thunder will gush out from the cloud she formed earlier, which it promptly does. The electricity passes through Kalifa's heart, as Nami predicted it would. Kalifa falls to the ground, defeated.  The scene changes to [[Franky]], who is looking for [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]. He climbs through a hole up to Nami's floor. Franky asks Nami about Chopper's mysterious [[Monster Point|new form]]. Neither of them know anything about it. In the courtyard right tower, more of the Jurors attack [[Mozu and Kiwi|Kiwi]] and the Franky Family members with her. In the right courtyard tower, [[Mozu and Kiwi|Mozu]] and her comrades are also being attacked. In the courtroom, [[Zambai]] is still dealing with Judge [[Baskerville]], who in turns claims all of his men are doomed as the Jurors are pirates sentenced to death and so in the whole history of [[Enies Lobby]] they have never once declared anyone innocent.  In the upstairs of the courtroom, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] hears the noise elsewhere and decides to head up by all else means. [[Nami]] comes face to face with two of the Jurors. Yokozuna is knocked aside outside the courtroom doors as the Jurors finally get the better of him after several blows. With the giant frog down, the Franky Family members start fighting. fields.page: 19}}  :''For fighting style with the same title, see [[Ramen Kenpo]]''  '''Chapter 369''' is titled "Ramen Kenpo".  ==Cover Page== [[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: "Crash! We Can Fight It!"  Framed portraits of all the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], placed in a jumble, each counting off the Straw Hat's join-order. [[Usopp]] is depicted in his Sogeking guise, while [[Nico Robin|Robin]] is depicted behind a chain to symbolize her captivity.  ==Short Summary== [[Sanji]] fights [[Wanze]] while [[Franky]] prepares to battle [[Nero]]. Meanwhile, [[Usopp|Sogeking]] has managed to reach the first coach!  ==Long Summary== The [[CP9]] are informed of the last two coaches being disconnected and that those in the fifth coach have been easily defeated. It is revealed that [[Nico Robin]] is in the first cart of the train and that the CP9 and [[Wanze]] are the only ones left to prevent her from being taken. They are also informed of the attackers appearances and conclude that the only thing they have to do is take both [[Franky]] and Nico Robin to [[Enies Lobby]] alive. They decide to focus on capturing Franky since saving Robin is impossible.  Meanwhile, on Coach Four, Wanze continues to prevent them from passing and [[Sanji]] decides to fight him while the other two progress to the next coach. He continues to prevent them from passing until Sanji attacks making him dodge and allowing the other two to pass. Wanze explains that [[Nero]] is in the next coach before being kicked by Sanji twelve times. Due to this, he uses [[Ramen Kenpo]] to create an armor around him.  Franky is greeted by Nero on the roof of the next coach and it is explained he cannot kill him since they need him alive. Franky lands the first hit after tricking Nero stating that he plays dirty since he is the underworld boss of his town. fields.text: See also the [[Merchandise FAQ]] page.}}A lot of bootlegs are produced mainly by Chinese/HK counterfeiters. One reliable way to recognize official products is by spotting the little Toei sticker put on the figure box.  Aside from the Toei sticker, other differences between official products and bootlegs may include differences in the box, lack in overall detail and taint/hue/depth in the paint on the figure itself. The bootlegs may be priced at the same price of the original figures or priced as a cheap counterfeit version for fans. Occasionally, they are sought by collectors despite being fake. The most notable way to tell a fake straight off is usually in the face as bootlegs are often less defined/detailed. One Piece P.O.P. also carry the Korean One Piece logo, the One Piece logo over a black flag, as they are intended for a wide target audience, a common sight on non-Japanese produced products. On the bootlegs, this logo may appear but often is poorly reproduced, along with the other logos on the box.  {{Gallery|position=left

fields.fruit: [[One Piece Magazine Vol.17]]}}  {{For|the non-canon [[Marines|Marine]]|Horo}}  The '''Horo Horo no Mi''' is a [[Paramecia]]-type [[Devil Fruit]] that allows the user to conjure ghosts,{{Qref|name=Devil Fruit Explanation|chap=461|page=12|ep=356|Perona explains her Devil Fruit ability.}} making the user a {{Nihongo|'''Ghost Human'''|霊体人間|Reitai Ningen}}.{{Qref|chap=474|page=7|ep=369|Zoro refers to Perona as a Ghost Human.}} It was eaten by [[Gill Bastar]],{{Qref|name=c1165|page=11|chap=1165|Gill with a ghost summoned.}}{{Qref|name=sbs114}} and sometime after its [[Devil Fruit#Growth|reincarnation]] it was eaten by [[Perona]].{{Qref|name=Devil Fruit Explanation}}  The powers of the fruit were first demonstrated by one of Perona's ghosts spying on the [[Straw Hat Pirates]],{{Qref|name=First Appearance}} but it was not until much later that the fruit itself was named.{{Qref|name=Devil Fruit Explanation}}  ==Etymology== *''Horo'' comes from {{Nihongo|''horō''|ホロー}}, the Japanese pronunciation of the English word "hollow" (referring to the fruit's ghost-like powers). *In the [[VIZ Media|VIZ]] manga and [[Funimation]] adaptations, it is called the '''Hollow-Hollow Fruit'''.  ==Appearance== The Horo Horo no Mi is pale-yellow fruit that below its green, T-shaped stem (whose ends curl down) splits into five elongated, obround sections that curve upward, vaguely reminiscent of a cluster of bananas. Each section is marked by a single characteristic Devil Fruit spiral on its rounded end, alongside two eye-like markings below that make such sections resemble sheeted ghosts.{{Qref|magazine=17|page=98|The Horo Horo no Mi's fruit design (supervised by Oda) is revealed.}}  ==Strengths== [[File:Horo Horo no Mi Power.png|thumb|left|210px|Perona surrounded by multiple Hollows.]]  The fruit bestows the ability to conjure forth {{Nihongo|'''ghosts'''|ゴースト|gōsuto}}, also referred to as {{Nihongo|'''Hollows'''|{{Ruby|霊体|ホロウ}}|Horō}}, that are fully under the user's control.{{Qref|name=Devil

fields.bounty: At least {{B|s}}100,000{{Qref|special=marinebounties}}}}  '''Seaman First Class Lines''' is a former subordinate of [[Fullbody]] from his time as a [[Marine Ranks#Lieutenant|lieutenant]].{{Qref|data=blue|page=48|Lines' name and rank are revealed.}}  ==Appearance== Lines has the standard Marine appearance, including the white shirt and Marine hat. In the anime, he had black hair, but in the manga, he has light-colored hair.{{Qref|name=c44}}  ==Personality== During his time on the [[Baratie]], he was scared of [[Gin]].{{Qref|name=c44}}  ==History== ===East Blue Saga=== ====Baratie Arc==== Lines, along with six other soldiers, were unfortunate enough to be beaten up by [[Gin]], [[Officer|right-hand man]] of the [[Krieg Pirates]], who was captured earlier but managed to escape despite being starved for three days. When Lines ran into [[Baratie]] to warn his [[Fullbody|superior]], he was shot in the back by Gin and collapsed to the floor,{{Qref|name=c44}} unconscious.{{Qref|name=vivre card}}  ==Anime and Manga Differences== In the anime, Lines was seen crawling away along with [[Fullbody]] as the [[Baratie]] [[Cook|chefs]] handled Gin. In the manga, he did not crawl away.  ==Trivia== *Lines is the only named Seaman First Class in the [[One Piece (Manga)|series]].  ==References== <References/>  ==Site Navigation== {{Marine Navibox}} [[ca:Lines]] [[de:Lines]] [[es:Lines]] [[fr:Lines]] [[it:Linz]] [[pl:Lines]] [[ru:Лайнс]] [[zh:萊茵斯]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Male Characters]] [[Category:Marines]] [[Category:East Blue Residents]]

fields.bounty: At least {{B|s}}100,000{{Qref|special=marinebounties}}}}  {{For|the anime [[Canon#Non-Canon|non-canon]] pirate of Foxy's crew|Mashikaku (Non-Canon)}}  '''Chief Petty Officer Mashikaku'''{{Qref|data=blue|page=56|Mashikaku's name is revealed.}} is a subordinate of [[Smoker]] and [[Tashigi]]. However, it is unknown if he remained with the two after they transferred to [[G-5]] as he is not seen with the G-5 Marines.  ==Appearance== Mashikaku's facial structure resembles that of a monkey, with bushy brown hair and sideburns, tanned skin, and a square jaw. His signature features are his sideburns that are curved and pointed inwards towards his face and his mouth that is pointed upwards when closed. He wears the standard Marine shirt and cap. In the manga, he wears epaulettes which may serve to differentiate himself in rank as a Chief Petty Officer. In the anime, however, he lacks the epaulettes and so, in terms of uniform, looks no different from a common Marine sailor.{{Qref|name=debut}}  During the [[Summit War of Marineford]], he wore a Marine officer's coat over his standard Marine shirt.{{Qref|name=c580|chap=580|Mashikaku watches on as Sengoku declares the war is over.}}  ===Gallery=== {{Gallery|position=center|height=130|width=130|captionalign=center

fields.imagetext: |name=One Piece in Arabic}}  [[File:Arabic One Piece Logo.png|left|thumb|The One Piece logo for the Arabic Dub (notice the skull in the "O" has been edited out)]]  The''' Arabic dub '''of One Piece was televised on [[Wikipedia:Space Power TV|Space Power Channel]], one of the most popular anime TV channels in the Arab world. It contains censorship, with varying degrees of application and consistency. For example, blood and violence is left intact in some episodes over others, in which case scenes depicting such were removed entirely. As a result, several episodes throughout its run went under the standard time duration, with the space being frequently filled by freeze framing, or slowing down and reversing footage. The most frequent and consistent edits were applied to female characters such as [[Nami]], [[Nojiko]], and [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]], due to showing cleavage or exposed skin. When possible, they will cut out the scene where the cleavage is shown and freeze frame to another character. There are a couple of instances where shirts were drawn on the female characters because the shots were impossible to edit out. Unlike most TV-edited dubs of One Piece, [[Sanji]]'s cigarettes and smoking habit is left fully intact. The original music score is kept, however there is a [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eCTTzec3Z7Y&feature=related new opening sequence] and some episodes had a new BGM score was placed beneath the next episode preview. The dub ceased production in 2010 at [[Episode 104]], shortly after the start of the [[Arabasta Arc]].  Since February 2021, One Piece has been airing fully uncensored and in Japanese with Arabic subtitles on the Middle Eastern Channel [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MBC_Action MBC Action], with no affiliation with Space Power or its release of the anime.  ==Voice Actors== {|class="wikitable" style="font-size:100%; border-collapse:collapse; border-color:#999;" border="1" cellpadding="0"

fields.dftype: [[Zoan]]}}  '''Boa Sandersonia'''{{Qref|name=vivre card}} is the younger sister of [[Boa Hancock]], the ruler of [[Amazon Lily]]. She is also one of the [[Officer|second-in commands]] of the [[Kuja Pirates]] and the older sister of [[Boa Marigold]]. She and her sisters are referred to by the Kuja as the [[Gorgon Sisters]].{{Qref|name=intro}}  ==Appearance== Sandersonia is a large woman who resembles a snake, with a curvaceous figure and large breasts like her sisters. Her head is disproportionately large and wide to her body and her long tongue is forked, often sticking out of her mouth and has sea green eyes (amber in snake form).  Like the rest of the [[Kuja]], she dresses in very revealing clothing: a green bikini top with white irregular patterns, a white cape over it and green panties encircled by flaps at both sides of her hips. She wears brown boots and a green stocking on her left leg with a design which resembles the [[Kuja Pirates]]' [[Jolly Roger]].  She is usually seen accompanied by the large panther, [[Bacura]], at her side instead of a snake like the other Kuja. Along with her sisters, her beauty is highly admired by the Amazon Lily islanders.{{Qref|name=intro}} In her younger days, Sandersonia was an average height teen who wore orange skirt and green top.{{Qref|chap=521|ep=415|page=15|Sandersonia is seen escaping along with her sisters.}}  Sandersonia wore a tan bra that seems to be bandaged of some sort, after her clothes were burned during the fight against [[Monkey D. Luffy]].  At [[Rusukaina]], Sandersonia’s attire does not change, with the exception of her cape and the designs of her bikini, which take the form of snake scales.  On her back, covered by her cape and her long green hair, is a mark of slavery branded on her by their previous [[World Noble|Celestial Dragon]] masters. It resembles a hoof mark and is a sign that means that she is "less than human" since she was a slave. Her sisters share this mark as well on their backs.{{Qref|name=R

fields.funi eva: Cara L. Reid}}  '''Sayo''' is [[Lina]]'s older sister. She appears during the [[Spa Island Arc]]. She and her sister are searching for the secret of how to create gems using their father's log.  ==Appearance== Sayo is a small child with brown hair and dark brown eyes. She wears a purple dress with a necklace with red beads. She also wears a golden bracelet on her left wrist.  ==Personality== She believes faithfully on her father's dream. We also see that she is extremely smart, as she can understand all of her fathers formulas. After her father left, she took over being the head of the house and caring for Lina. Extremely mature for her age, she is very responsible.  ==History== === Past === When she was very young, her mother died. Her sister was just a baby. From a young age she had to be the mother of the house taking care of everyone. After her father left, she spent a good amount of time studying her father's notebook, learning the formulas. She and her sister were searching for the secret of creating gems using their father's log.  === Thriller Bark Saga === ==== Spa Island Arc ==== She and her sister went to [[Spa Island]] to look for the last part and end up befriending [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Straw Hat Pirates|his crew]]. She was taken hostage by the spa owner to get the secret. Later on she found out that her father did not abandon them.{{Qref|name=Debut}}  ==References== <References/>  ==Site Navigation== {{Spa Island Navibox}} {{Straw Hat Pirates Allies Navibox}}  [[ca:Sayo]] [[fr:Sayo]] [[it:Sayo]] [[Category:Non-Canon Humans]] [[Category:Non-Canon Female Characters]] [[Category:Non-Canon Children]]

fields.next: Dear Friends}}  {{For|thisis=about the anime ending|the object|Eternal Pose}}  '''Eternal Pose''' (エターナルポーズ ''Etānaru Pōzu'') is the fifteenth ending of the [[One Piece (Anime)|One Piece anime]] by Asia Engineer. The animation in this ending pans through several iterations of the Straw Hats as they were at earlier episodes of the anime, including the clothing they predominately wore during a specific arc. The first five iterations show [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Nami]], [[Usopp]], and [[Sanji]]. After the sixth iteration, [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] are added in. This ending ran from [[Episode 231]] to [[Episode 245]]. Due to licensing issues with the [[Mirai Kōkai|previous ending]], this ending is featured in the Funimation DVD release of the series starting on [[Episode 207]].  ==Ending== The ending just shows the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] from the [[Romance Dawn Arc]] to the [[Water 7 Arc]] from left to right.  ==Lyrics (TV version)== {| border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:43.12%;border-collapse:collapse;" width="43%"

fields.filler: true}}  '''"Zoro Sharpens His Fangs! A Fight With a Wild Beast!"''' is the 223rd episode of the [[One Piece (Anime)|''One Piece'' anime]].  ==Short Summary== On their way to "The Palace of the Sea God," [[Nico Robin|Robin]]'s group meets an entranced [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]. It appears that Zoro wants to fight, so [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] urges the others to keep going without him. They apprehend the boy that they had believed had stolen their memories. However it is revealed that the seahorse was really stealing their memories. Zoro returns, still entranced, but Luffy is nowhere to be seen.  ==Long Summary== The Straw Hats travel through the forest to find the Palace of the Sea God. Usopp and Chopper are chased by a snake. After losing the snake, they become separated from the others. They also run into Zoro, who awkwardly ignores them. However, when Zoro finally sees Luffy, he attacks Luffy using his swords. The Straw Hats believe that Zoro was hypnotized.  Luffy tells the others to go ahead to the temple, while he stayed behind to battle Zoro. Zoro defeats Luffy with an Oni Giri move. Meanwhile, on the way to the Palace, Nami tells the Straw Hats that Luffy and Robin are lying to them, and that they should go home. However, the Straw Hats decide to stay with Robin, and they leave Nami behind. Nami, however, decides to follow the Straw Hats to reclaim her gold. Back in the forest, Zoro and Luffy continue to engage in the fight.  Upon arriving at the Palace, Robin explains that there is a legendary monster that would feed on others' memories to survive, and that the monster resided in the island. Nami and Usopp try to reach the Straw Hats, but are approached by the cloaked boy. Sanji leaps into the air and kicks the boy, causing the seahorse horn to release the Straw Hats' memories and also play a sound. fields.chardebut: [[Camie]], [[Pappag]]}}  '''"Arriving at Halfway Through the Grand Line! The Red Line"''' is the 385th episode of the [[One Piece (Anime)|''One Piece'' anime]].  ==Short Summary== [[Sengoku]] complains about [[Bartholomew Kuma|Kuma]]'s sparing of the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], but [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] is confident that they will not talk about defeating [[Gecko Moria|Moria]]. The Straw Hats reach the [[Red Line]], on the other side of the world from where they entered the [[Grand Line]], and briefly reflect on how far they have come and just how far they have to go. [[Nico Robin|Robin]], [[Brook]], and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] investigate with the [[Shark Submerge III]] to see how they could get to [[Fish-Man Island]] but are unable to go deep enough to find any clues. A [[Sea Rabbit]] attacks them, and after they defeat it, it spits out a [[Merfolk|mermaid]] named [[Camie]] and her starfish pet, [[Pappag]].  ==Long Summary== In the Holy Land of [[Mary Geoise]], Kuma appears before Sengoku who demands why he let the Straw Hat pirates go. Garp accepts his grandson's tenacity to the anger of his superior. The older admiral says that no one will believe Luffy's story on how he had beaten Moria. Sengoku knows that because Kuma showed compassion to the Straw Hats, if they follow their log pose continually, they'll reach the Navy Headquarters. Garp then presents some tea that Sengoku rejects.  On the Thousand Sunny, the Straw Hats begin to feel bored while Luffy, Chopper, Usopp and Brook they are fishing as Zoro and the others have tea. Luffy complains the group hasn't arrived at Fish-Man Island yet while Nami warns they will be closing in. Sanji thinks of mermaids, but then Usopp spots a school of fish. Nami spots that the fish are trying to swim away from something. Just then, the Thousand Sunny finds itself in a seasnake current. The waters form large columns shocking the crew. Zoro vs. Baroque Works!"''' is the 65th episode of the [[One Piece (Anime)|''One Piece'' anime]].  ==Short Summary== [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] finally defeats the [[Millions]] and the agents and [[Nami]] wakes up and went to find treasure that led her outside. But [[Gem|Mr. 5]] and [[Mikita|Miss Valentine]] arrive to arrest [[Igaram|Mr. 8]] and [[Nefertari Vivi|Miss Wednesday]] as they are important members of [[Arabasta|Arabasta kingdom]] and they knew the [[Crocodile|Boss]]' secret.  ==Long Summary== The [[Billions]] of the [[Baroque Works]] confused on why [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] disappeared, they started to look for him when suddenly Zoro was right in the middle of the crowd looking up at the roof he was from. The people around him started shooting but they ended up shooting each other as Zoro once again disappeared. [[Igaram|Mr. 8]] commanded them to kill him because he is just one swordsman. Suddenly, Zoro was back-to-back with Mr. 8 and Zoro slides his sword through Mr. 8's hair. Zoro asked Mr. 8 if adding only one grave is enough. The Billions found Zoro on Mr. 8's back and as they were to shoot him, Mr. 8 shot them with his saxophone fearing he would be shot, too.  It is revealed where Zoro is disappearing to as he is seen hiding on a wall. [[Mr. 9]] was convinced that they have to deal with him themselves. Meanwhile, in the bar, Nami is awake and was really not drunk. She discovered that the [[Whisky Peak|"welcoming town"]] is a nest of bounty hunters. Outside, as Zoro attempts to test [[Yubashiri]] and [[Sandai Kitetsu]], his 2 new swords, a Billion on the roof of the building Zoro was hiding found him and shot him. Zoro dodged the shot and went inside the house but many Billions was outside and started shooting him. He flipped a table and went behind it like a shield. fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 555''' is titled "Oars and the [[Wikipedia:Kasa (hat)|Kasa]]".  ==Cover Page== [[Straw Hat's Separation Serial]]: [[Nami]]'s "Weather Report", Nami starts her story in [[Weatheria]], where [[Haredas|the weather professor]] trades with other people.  ==Short Summary== [[Little Oars Jr.|Oars Jr.]] enters the battle and defeats crashes through enemy lines. The [[Shichibukai]] mobilize, and Oars is brought down after taking heavy damage.  ==Long Summary== ====Marineford==== The [[Giant Squad]] of the [[Marines]] heads forward, to tackle the monstrous [[Little Oars Jr.]]; two giants talk to each other, saying that it is the first time they are actually looking up at someone. [[Marines]] try to tackle Oars Jr. full on, with a terrified [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] watching. [[Sengoku]] comments that Oars Jr. is quite the ally. However, Ace shouts at Oars Jr., stating that due to his size, he would be an unfortunate target. Oars Jr. keeps going, determined to save Ace.  The behemoth of Oars Jr. picks up a Marine warship by the mast and uses it as a hammer, creating a hole in the Marine defense. A Marine looks on, saying that the situation is bad and orders a retreat so that the pirates would not get to the execution platform. A [[vice admiral]] falls to the despair of the Marines. Whitebeard states that Oars Jr. is a fool and that he has no idea what to do with him. He goes on to say that there is a difference between heroism and suicide. Oars Jr. shouts at his Captain, saying that all he wants is to save Ace. Whitebeard agrees, ordering his men to back up the giant. Oars Jr. keeps fighting, scaring the living daylights out of the Marines.  [[Boa Hancock]] looks on and decides to act, using her [[Mero Mero no Mi]] by blowing a heart shaped balloon and using a move called '''Slave Arrow'''. A [[Whitebeard Pirates|Whitebeard pirate]] recognizes the Pirate Empress but is slowly turned to stone. She uses another move, '''Perfume Femur''', attacking Whitebeard Pirates

fields.funi eva: Uncredited}}  '''Kitajima''' is a character from the [[One Piece Film: Strong World|tenth]] movie. He is a [[Fish-Men|fish-man]] pirate who is one of the many pirates that allied with [[Shiki]].  ==Appearance== Kitajima is a green-colored fishman. He wears a blue-colored shirt with a black tie and black pants hold up by a belt. He also has sunglasses with orange lenses.  ==Personality== Not much is known about his personality.  ==Abilities and Powers== As a [[Fish-Men|fish-man]], Kitajima is at least ten times stronger than a normal human. He is also seen using a [[sword]], though it is not known how skilled he is with it.  ==History== ===One Piece Film: Strong World=== He was first seen having dinner with the other gathered pirates at Shiki's palace. He took part in a conversation with [[Nico Robin|Robin]] concerning Shiki's plans for the [[East Blue]].  During the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]' attack on Shiki's palace, Kitajima ordered his men to attack [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] but they were subdued by [[Brook]].  ==Trivia== [[File:Kitajima.png|thumb|210px|Kosuke Kitajima]] * He is voiced by [[Wikipedia:Kosuke Kitajima|Kosuke Kitajima]], and named after him due to his record as an Olympic swimmer.{{Qref|movie=10|Kitajima appears as one of the pirates allied with Shiki.}} {{-}}  ==References== <References/> {{-}}  ==Site Navigation== {{Golden Lion Pirates Navibox}} {{Fish-Men Navibox}} {{MSchar Navibox}} [[ca:Kitajima]] [[de:Kitajima]] [[es:Kitajima]] [[fr:Kitajima]] [[Category:Non-Canon Male Characters]] [[Category:Non-Canon Swordsmen]] [[Category:Non-Canon Pirates]] [[Category:Movie 10 Antagonists]] [[Category:Non-Canon Fish-Men]]

fields.page: 17}} '''Chapter 565''' is titled "Oars' Path".  ==Cover Page== [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and Animals: Brook being painted by Zebra wearing pants.  ==Short Summary== Due to the video feed being cut, many people at [[Sabaody Archipelago]] are now confused, while the [[Eleven Supernovas|Supernovas]] suspect something. At Marineford, [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]'s [[Magu Magu no Mi|magma]] has robbed the pirates of their footing and destroyed [[Moby Dick|one of their ships]]. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] manages to cross the wall by having [[Jinbe]] propel him and a mast over on a [[Fish-Man Karate|column of water]], but he runs into the three [[admirals]]. Meanwhile, [[Little Oars Jr.|Oars Jr.]] is awakened by the impact of the wall, and [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] tells [[Jozu]] to prepare the trump card to breach the wall.  ==Long Summary== Back at the [[Sabaody Archipelago]], reporters and bystanders are complaining about the video feed getting cut. They barrage the stationed [[Marines]] with questions, asking if [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] and the Marines really made a bargain and if Whitebeard sold out his allies. [[Eustass Kid]] and crew decide to leave since the show is over. The other [[the Eleven Supernovas|Supernovas]], all alive and well on Sabaody, comment on the situation.  Meanwhile, [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]'s attack is wreaking havoc on the pirates, destroying all their footing. [[Moby Dick]] is struck down in the attack, and is completely destroyed. As the sea water begins to turn to magma, the cannons from within the iron wall begin firing at the pirates, restraining them at the center of the enclosure. Whitebeard attempts to use his [[Gura Gura no Mi]] powers to smash through a section of the wall, but the blow only dents it.  Seeings as everything is going according to plan, [[Sengoku]] announces that it is time to execute [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]. The pirates decide that to reach Ace they need to travel over [[Little Oars Jr.]] As [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]

fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 566''' is titled "Raid".  ==Cover Page== [[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] relaxing by a stream and enjoying cola.  ==Short Summary== [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] attempts to pass the [[admirals]], but is knocked back by [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] and stabbed by [[Kuzan|Aokiji]], forcing [[Polo Marco|Marco]] to intervene. The executioners attempt to kill [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]], but [[Crocodile]] stops them, forcing [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] to behead the former [[Shichibukai]]. Unaffected, Crocodile clashes with Doflamingo as the [[Whitebeard Pirates]] breach the wall. As Whitebeard blasts his way through the [[Marines]], [[Sengoku]] states that he and [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]] must participate in the war. ==Long Summary== As the [[admirals]] dodge the projectiles formed from the frozen mast, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] activates Gear Second, hoping to make a straight dash for [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]]. However, [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] easily catches up to him and knocks him aside with a kick at [[Pika Pika no Mi|light-speed]].  Up on the execution platform, the guards are about to execute Ace. However, they are blown back by an unknown force, which is revealed to be an attack by none other than [[Crocodile]]. While [[Sengoku]] wonders why Crocodile would aid his own enemy, the former [[Shichibukai]] notes that he only did it because he did not want to see the [[Marines]] be satisfied. Suddenly, taking everyone by surprise, Crocodile's head comes flying off of his body. [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]], standing behind Crocodile, says that he is jealous that he had decided to side with Whitebeard instead of him. Forming his head back onto his body, Crocodile responds that he is not teaming up with anyone and attacks Doflamingo. fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 567''' is titled "Marineford Marine Headquarters - Oris Plaza".  ==Cover Page== [[Color spreads|Color spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] with their numbers as various fruit themed superheroes.  ==Short Summary== As [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] prepares to launch another attack, he is blocked by [[Kuzan|Aokiji]], forcing [[Jozu]] to step in. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], progressing through the [[Marines]], is attacked and thrown by back by a pair of [[Vice Admirals]] and [[Admiral]] [[Borsalino|Kizaru]]. Whitebeard tells Luffy to stay back, and proceeds to clash with [[Sakazuki|Akainu]]. [[Polo Marco|Marco]], meanwhile, makes a beeline for [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]], but is punched away by [[Monkey D. Garp|Garp]]. ==Long Summary== The Whitebeard Pirates and their subordinate crews began their assault on the plaza. Whitebeard prepares to use a devastating attack, but Admiral [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] freezes Whitebeard using Ice Ball. Whitebeard breaks free from the ice he was encased in and attacked Aokiji. Aokiji prepares to counter with Ice Block Partisan, but [[Jozu]] attacked him before he can do so. Jozu and Aokiji prepare to face off against each other.  [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], meanwhile, continues to move toward the execution platform. However, Momonga and Dalmatian stand in Luffy's way and attack him. Luffy then gets struck down by Admiral Kizaru, who told Luffy that courage alone is not enough and kicked him away. Luffy is sent flying and is then caught by Whitebeard. Kizaru chides [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] for allowing Luffy to lead the charge. Whitebeard then hand Luffy to his men and says that Luffy has done enough. As Whitebeard's men try to tend to Luffy's wounds, Luffy insisted to go on but soon collapses. Whitebeard comments on how he held a soft spot for people like Luffy. [[Squard]] charges in with one of [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s ships, but Whitebeard stops it, saying that his crew must return to the New World alive. As [[Whitebeard Pirates|his crew]] and allies look on in amazement, Whitebeard states that it is time to settle matters with the Marines.  ==Long Summary== All of Whitebeard's allies cheer on [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] for their efforts, while the Impel Down escapees stand amazed at Luffy's feats up to that point. The [[Marines]] brace themselves to stop Ace and Luffy, who get ready to break through. As the Marines open fire, Ace and Luffy easily fight back against the soldiers. Whitebeard's forces try to create a path for Luffy and Ace, while the Marines continue to attempt to execute the two. [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] fires a mass of ice at them, which Ace blocks with an enormous wall of fire. [[Sengoku]] grumbles in disgrace that he had allowed the two to get away; [[Donquixote Doflamingo|Doflamingo]] suggests they let them get away to make things more interesting, which Vice Admiral [[Momonga]] scolds him for; [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] swears that he will not allow any of them to leave; the Marines come across [[Galdino|Mr. 3]], who is lying exhausted from his actions.  Whitebeard's extra ship suddenly comes plowing through Marineford, being driven by [[Squard]]. Squard reveals that he wishes to stall the Marines while the others escape. fields.page: 15}} '''Chapter 575''' is titled "Voiceless Rage".  ==Cover Page== [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and Animals: [[Sanji]] and [[Usopp]] relaxing and watching the stars while riding a camel.  ==Short Summary== Following the death of [[Portgas D. Ace]] at the hands of [[Admiral]] [[Sakazuki|Akainu]], [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has gone into shock and is now in danger of death. Akainu moves to eliminate Luffy, but [[Polo Marco|Marco]] comes to his aid and stops Akainu while [[Jinbe]] escapes with Luffy. An enraged [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] attacks Akainu and knocks him into a huge fissure while simultaneously splitting [[Marineford]] into two pieces. However, Akainu manages to burn off a portion of Whitebeard's head. Just then, the [[Blackbeard Pirates]] arrive at the battlefield along with some new crew members, one of which is an immense figure the size of Marineford's main building. [[Sengoku]] and the [[Marines]] are stunned.  ==Long Summary== The chapter starts with a flashback of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] having a drink and becoming brothers. Everyone is sad because of Ace's death. [[Emporio Ivankov|Ivankov]] notes that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has mentally collapsed and that his life is now in danger. [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] attempts to kill Luffy, but [[Polo Marco|Marco]] interrupts the attack. Marco orders [[Jinbe]] to take Luffy with him. Marco swears that the [[Whitebeard Pirates]] will protect him in place of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] and if they let him die, they would consider it shame on the entire Whitebeard Pirates. Whitebeard, who was observing the situation, attacks Akainu from the back without saying a word. [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] goes down and his face is covered in blood. Akainu retaliates with a punch that takes out a portion of Whitebeard's head. Whitebeard then punches Akainu a second time which also causes massive destruction to the Marine HQ itself. He has a mustache that consists of two straight points angled diagonally. He wears a typical outfit consisting of a yellow coat with green linings, a green vest under an unbuttoned shirt, a standard light green pirate sash, square-patterned pants, and standard boots. His outfit most notably includes a yellow and purple bandanna bearing Whitebeard's mark. He is often seen wielding a unique spiked ball and chain that has a face at the end. fields.chardebut: [[Sancrin]]}}  '''"The Crewmates' Whereabouts - The Giant Gravestone and Panties of Gratitude"''' is the 456th episode of the [[One Piece (Anime)|''One Piece'' anime]].  ==Short Summary== While heading to the sea to return to the [[Sabaody Archipelago]], [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Perona]] stumble upon an enormous tombstone. [[Brook]] decides he has to wait to find [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and the [[Straw Hat Pirates|others]] until he can fulfill his debt to the people of [[Namakura Island|Harahettania]].  ==Long Summary==  {{Empty section|date=September 2013}}  ==Characters in Order of Appearance== {{Scroll Box| * [[Roronoa Zoro]] * [[Perona]] * [[Pacifista|PX-1]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Sanji]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Franky]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Nami]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Tony Tony Chopper]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Nico Robin]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Sentomaru]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Usopp]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Bartholomew Kuma]] ''(flashback)'' * [[Brook]] * [[Pekkori]] * [[Sancrin]] * [[Monkey D. Luffy]] * [[Jinbe]] * [[Crocodile]] * [[Portgas D. Ace]]}}  ==Anime Notes== * The anime adds the following: ** Perona giving Zoro his swords back onscreen. ** The cultists on Namakura Island telling Brook their story. ** While still on the way to Marineford, Jinbe and Crocodile got into another argument and were about to fight each other. * This is the last episode of the [[Straw Hat's Separation Serial]]. * In the Japanese DVD [[FUNimation Entertainment|FUNimation subs]], the Zoro parts have some differences with the original episode. The shadowed figures were less shadowed, the number of the "beasts" in the last scene was much higher, and the camera movement was different from the bottom-up changed to left-right.  {{Gallery|width=160|height=90|captionalign=center|position=center

fields.name: וואן פיס}} [[File:One Piece Hebrew To be Continued.png|thumb|226px|right|The "To be continued" Card at the end of each episode.]]  '''One Piece''' (וואן פיס) '''in Israel''' was dubbed by Elrom productions and aired on the channel Jetix(ג'טיקס) in October 14, 2006. While the dub hardly features any censorship, the openings and endings are dubbed into Hebrew, and the ''One Piece'' logo and the "to be continued" card at the end of the show are translated. Only the first [[Episode 52|52 episodes]] were dubbed and broadcast on TV before the series was eventually dropped, mainly due to Jetix deeming the show too violent for children.  The Hebrew dub barely featured any censorship; the part in which [[Arlong]] shoots [[Bell-mère|Belle-mère]] to death in [[Episode 36]] was cut, but was later shown uncensored in the [[Episode 37|following episode]] during the previous episode's recap.  [[We Are!]] was performed by Sharon Cohen, and [[Memories]], [[RUN! RUN! RUN!]], and [[Believe]] were performed by Hadar Shahaf-Ma'ayan. These four songs were translated into Hebrew by Ziv Meir.  While the dialogue had no subtitles, subtitles appeared when the title of the episode was spoken. fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 629''' is titled "Former Warlord in the Way".  ==Cover Page== [[From the Decks of the World]] Vol. 14 - "[[Cocoyasi Village]]".  ==Short Summary== [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] continues his fight with [[Jinbe]] because he wants to deal with [[Hody Jones|Hody]] alone. [[Nico Robin|Robin]] appears in the middle of the fight, surprising everyone, throwing them off. Meanwhile, Jones starts to move residents from the [[Fish-Man District]] to the island. In [[Candy Factory Town]], [[Daruma]] says that he will gather everyone at [[Gyoncorde Plaza]]. In [[Ryugu Palace]], inside the pool area, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Usopp]], and [[Brook]] are still trapped and try to find a way to escape with Brook's new ability.  ==Long Summary== [[Jinbe]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] argue about how to handle the [[Hody Jones]] situation, while everyone else tries to convince them not to fight. Luffy attempts to get away on [[Megalo]], but Jinbe hits him with a [[Fish-Man Karate]] attack. Everyone wonders how the attack could hurt Luffy. Jinbe explains that Fish-Man Karate users control the water around them, and since all living creatures are technically nothing but water sacks, even Luffy is weak against it. Luffy uses a "Gomu Gomu no Jet Stamp" on Jinbe, but it barely injures him as he parries the hit. They attempt to fight again, but [[Nico Robin|Robin]] appear in between them, saying that is enough fighting. Luffy and Jinbe tell her to move, [[Sanji]], thinking Robin is in danger, leaps toward her, Robin disappears, leaving Sanji in the crossfire of Luffy's and Jinbe's punches towards each other. As the three fall on the ground, Robin comes out of the forest, confusing [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]. Jinbe tells Luffy that if he, the man who stopped [[Arlong]], took down Hody, the wall between humans and fish-men would only get stronger. fields.title: The Ancient Ark
fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 637''' is titled "The Ancient Ark".  ==Cover page== [[From the Decks of the World]] Vol. 21: "Drum Island - Medical Center Isshi-100".  ==Short Summary== [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s strength is overwhelming [[Hody Jones]] leaving everyone observing amazed at his power. He uses [[Haki]] to attack Hody, however Hody is very resilient, and gets back up.  [[Noah]] is seen arriving at [[Fish-Man Island]] with [[Vander Decken IX]] onboard. As the ark nearly breaks through the bubble surrounding Fish-Man Island, [[Shirahoshi]] leaves the plaza to draw the ark away. She stands in front of Decken as she asks him to only kill her and leave the island alone.  Hody is then seen climbing on one of the chains at the bottom of the ark, looking furious. [[Sanji]] then quickly runs to Noah, but Luffy stops him and decides to head to Noah himself.  ==Long Summary== The [[New Fish-Man Pirates]] are amazed at [[Hody Jones]]' new found strength and endurance and that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] was able to hurt him. Luffy comments that Hody is built like a tank. Hody asks Luffy if he knows what [[Fish-Man Karate]] is as he thrusts his palm forward. Luffy's head goes flying back, and the pirates think he is finished, but Luffy tells Hody it will not work on him since he is made of rubber. Luffy then imbues his forehead with Armament Haki. Before he can shoot back, the Iron Shell Division gets in front of Hody, shielding him from the attack. Luffy smashes into them, knocking them out using Gomu Gomu no Kane. Jones is about to attack Luffy with a backward roundhouse kick, but Luffy imbues Armament Haki into his arm and stops Hody's kick, injuring Hody in the process. He then throws his legs over his head and delivers a devastating Haki-imbued kick to Hody's head. Hody attacks Luffy with Yabusame, but Luffy manages to dodge all of them using Kenbunshoku Haki. He then delivers a Haki-imbued punch to Hody's stomach, blasting him into the rock wall around the plaza. Everyone is a

fields.title: Escape-Hoshi
fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 638''' is titled "Escape-Hoshi".  ==Cover Page== [[From the Decks of the World]] Vol. 22 - "Arabasta Kingdom - Royal Minister of the Environment, Koza".  ==Short Summary== [[Shirahoshi]] runs away from [[Noah]] trying to get outside of Fish-Man Island to save the bubble around it. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is sent flying toward the ark with [[Sanji]]'s help. Inhabitants of [[Fish-Man Island]] try to slow the arc down by pushing and pulling it, but [[Hody Jones]] disposes of them for being worthless. Then Shirahoshi manages to get out of [[Fish-Man Island]] and continues to lure the ship out, as Luffy and Hody follow her and Hody sees a chance to kill him. Shirahoshi refuses another one of Decken's proposals and is saved from his attack by her brothers and [[Hoe]] while [[Fukaboshi]] saves Luffy. Hody tries to attack them with his [[Kirisame]], but it misses so then he gets on Noah and impales Decken with his trident.  ==Long Summary== [[Noah]] is going slightly away from the island, thanks to [[Shirahoshi]]'s efforts. She realizes she has to get into the ocean or the bubble will burst. The main entrance is too far but she has an idea. As [[Hody Jones]] climbs the chain, the citizens try to think of something they can do for her. Meanwhile, [[Sanji]] is carefully calculating the force with which he must launch [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], and throws him with Armée de l'Air Rubber Shoot. He overshoots it slightly and Luffy goes out into the ocean but is close enough so he can grab onto the chain, remarking how huge it is. Luffy looks down and sees Hody below him. He then sees the citizens in the plaza grab the chain in an attempt to slow the enormous boat down. Shirahoshi is touched by their actions. However, Hody is annoyed at them, saying they will not slow it down at all, while Luffy vociferates loudly to stop. fields.page: 19}} '''Chapter 639''' is titled "Protect Everything".  ==Cover Page== [[From the Decks of the World]] Vol. 23 - "Arabasta Kingdom - New Clothes for This Year's [[Levely]]"  ==Short Summary== [[Hody Jones]] takes his trident out of [[Vander Decken IX|Decken]]'s body and after a short fight, Decken is defeated. After that, Hody goes after [[Shirahoshi]], slicing through [[Ryuboshi]] and [[Manboshi]] and reaching her with the uncomparable underwater speed, grabbing her hair. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] attacks Hody managing to make him release her. [[Zeo]] makes [[Wadatsumi]] believe that he has to fight for the [[New Fish-Man Pirates]] in [[Gyoncorde Plaza]]. Wadatsumi defeats [[Surume]] and then as he attacks [[Jinbe]] and gets pushed back, he manages to bring down Nami, which gives Sanji a reason to attack him. [[Hyouzou]] becomes stronger after eating too many [[Energy Steroids]]. He tries to attack [[Nico Robin|Robin]] but [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] jumps in front of him and stops his attack.  ==Long Summary== [[Hody Jones|Hody]] pulls his trident out of [[Vander Decken IX|Decken]] and Decken reveals he touched Hody with his left hand at the last minute and throws an axe at him. Hody tells Decken he betrayed him first, but destroying the island was a great idea. If Decken were to die, the effects of his ability would disappear. Hody then suggests turning the ship around and dealing with the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]. Decken says he does not care about them, since he is going to kill Hody first. He then lashes out with a kick, revealing blades hidden in his shoes. Hody catches the leg with his teeth and bites down on it. He then swings Decken around and uses him as a shield to intercept the axe thrown earlier. Hody laughs and says he has to kill [[Shirahoshi]] before the ship crashes. She was the daughter of [[Oran]] and [[Roji]], the niece of [[Nico Olvia]], and the cousin of [[Nico Robin]].  ==Appearance== Mizuira was a little girl with a large smile. She had blonde curly hair, with a ribbon in it.  ==Personality== Very little is known about her personality, but it is evident that she was not close to her cousin Robin as she did not complain when her mother refused to bring the little girl for the family dinner.  ==History== ===Biography=== Her parents took her out to dinner at a restaurant for her eighth birthday. Roji wanted it to be a private affair so they did not bring Robin along with them. She is assumed to have died after the escape ship was destroyed by [[Vice Admiral]] [[Sakazuki]].{{Qref|chap=397|page=11-12|ep=278}}  ==Trivia== *Her name is likely derived from the phrase {{Nihongo|''mizuirazu''|水入らず||literally meaning "privately; with no outsiders present​"}}, referring to her birthday dinner to which [[Nico Robin|Robin]] was not invited.  ==References== <references />  ==Site Navigation== {{Ohara Navibox}} {{West Blue Characters Navibox}} [[ca:Mizuira]] [[es:Mizuira]] [[fr:Mizuira]] [[pl:Mizuira]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Deceased Characters]] [[Category:Flashback Introduction Characters]] [[Category:Female Characters]] [[Category:Children]] [[Category:Ohara Residents]]

fields.first: [[Chapter 672]]; [[Episode 598]]{{Qref|name=Foxfire|chap=672|page=16-19|ep=598|Kin'emon is seen using Foxfire Style for the first time and cuts through an explosion.}}}}  '''Foxfire Style''' is a style of sword fighting used by the [[samurai]], [[Kin'emon]]. Later on, [[Roronoa Zoro]] learned how to perform the style and implement it in his swordsmanship.{{Qref|name=c1001|chap=1001|page=5-6|ep=1016}}  ==Overview== Foxfire Style allows the user to generate, attack with, and cut through fire. This ability allows Kin'emon to cut through flames and explosions while completely protecting himself from harm, giving it a strong defensive use. For offense, the generated fire enhances Kin'emon's regular attacks and is useful against creatures susceptible to heat.{{Qref|name=Foxfire}}  This style can further be used for first aid, with the fire being capable of cauterizing potentially deadly wounds.{{Qref|chap=994|page=3|ep=1006|Kin'emon cauterizes Kikunojo's amputation.}}  [[Roronoa Zoro]], having seen Kin'emon use this fighting style, later uses it to cut [[Prometheus]] in half,{{Qref|name=c1001}} and then started combining it with his own techniques.{{Qref|name=c1002|chap=1002|page=12-13|ep=1017|Zoro uses an enhanced version of "Hiryu: Kaen".}}{{Qref|name=c1009|chap=1009|page=16|ep=1026|Zoro uses an enhanced version of "Rokudo no Tsuji".}}  ==Techniques== ===Kin'emon=== [[File:Brook and Kin'emon Defeat Vegapunk's Second Dragon.png|thumb|210px|Homura Saki.]] *{{Nihongo|'''Homura Saki'''|焔裂き|Homura Saki|literally meaning "Flame Split"}}: Kin'emon slashes his sword to slice an incoming fire attack. fields.gladiator number: 0421}}  '''Hera''' is a gladiator at the [[Corrida Colosseum]] that competed for the [[Mera Mera no Mi]].{{Qref|name=c703}}  ==Appearance== Hera is a tall man with thick muscles. He is bare-chested and barefoot. He wears a spiked ridge helmet, studded wristbands, and a dark [[Wikipedia:Paludamentum|paludamentum]]. The back of his paludamentum bears his name and participant number. He also carries a longsword.  ==Abilities and Powers== He is seen wielding a sword in the gladiator waiting room, but it is unknown how well he wields it.  ==History== ===Dressrosa Saga=== ====Dressrosa Arc==== Hera was in the waiting room when [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] arrived, waiting for his turn to fight.{{Qref|name=c703}}  ==Anime and Manga Differences== The manga did not state which block he was placed in, but a scene in the anime listed him as registered in D Block.{{Qref|ep=633|Thunder Soldier looks at a board listing the notable gladiators from each block.}}  ==Trivia== *In Greek mythology, [[Wikipedia:Hera|Hera]] is the name of the goddess of marriage, women and birth. fields.focus: Vibrations{{Qref|name=c715}}; [[Haki/Armament Haki|Haki]]{{Qref|chap=716}}}}  '''Hasshoken''' is a martial art{{Qref|chap=716|page=5|ep=646|Sai mentions his Hasshoken training.}} used by the [[Chinjao Family]].{{Qref|name=c715}} It is a martial art that allows the user to produce powerful shockwaves.  ==Users== {{Hasshoken Users Gallery}}  ==Description== According to [[Gatz]], this fighting style allows the user to control the vibrations of the whole body, allowing them to create powerful shock waves. These shock waves are powerful enough to destroy a metal shield or easily defeat a strong man. [[Sai]] also claimed that these attacks are unblockable and reverberating, causing defenses to shatter.{{Qref|name=c715}}  The only drawback is that the shockwaves can be countered by a significant amount of force, as Sai's shockwaves were countered by Ideo's explosive punches, and Chinjao's every shockwave was countered during his fight with Luffy in Block C.  ===Variations=== This fighting style can be used on any part of the user's body, be it the head, fists, legs or elbows. Or on the whole body at once.{{Qref|name=c715}}  {{Gallery|position=center|width=200|height=150

fields.next: [[Dressrosa Arc]]}}  The '''Caesar Retrieval Arc''' is the eleventh [[filler]] arc, and the second filler arc after the time skip.  In this arc, a [[Breed|mysterious person]] manages to get into the [[Thousand Sunny]] and kidnap the already-kidnapped [[Caesar Clown]] away from the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], who are on their way to [[Dressrosa]]. However, the recently formed [[Heart Pirates|Heart]]-[[Straw Hat Pirates|Hat]] alliance will need to get Caesar back, in order to keep up the plan to take down both [[Donquixote Doflamingo]] and [[Kaidou]]. But it seems that retrieving the [[scientist]] won't be that easy, as the person has [[Peto Peto no Mi|abnormal abilities]].  ==Summary== After [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Trafalgar Law]] and the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] left [[Punk Hazard]] with [[Caesar Clown]] in hand, they are wary of being attacked by Doflamingo. A group of dark figures board the [[Thousand Sunny]] and attack the crew members, ceasing only at the command of a strange man named [[Breed]], who has captured Caesar. Law, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] pursue him in the [[Shark Submerge III]], and sneak into Breed's ship.  Breed locks Caesar in a cell, and explains his intentions. It is revealed that Breed does not work for Doflamingo, but he is connected to the underworld.  He also knows of Caesar's abilities as a scientist, and kidnapped him in order for Caesar to help in creating his dream world.  As Luffy's group arrive at the center of Breed's ship, which is designed like an aquarium, they once again get attacked by the mysterious figures. They are revealed to be animals, enslaved by Breed's [[Peto Peto no Mi|ability]]. Luffy defeats their leader, who turns out to be [[Kung-Fu Dugongs|one of the Kung-Fu Dugongs]] he befriended in [[Arabasta]]. After the Straw Hats left Arabasta, it started a pirate group with other sea creatures to follow Luffy's dreams as well. Breed enslaved the group and is forcing them to do his bid

fields.status: Destroyed}}  '''Groseade''' was the [[ship]] of the [[World Pirates]].  ==Ship Design and Appearance== The Groseade was a giant [[ship]] taking the form of an [[Wikipedia:Artificial island|artificial island]] or an [[Wikipedia:Aircraft carrier|aircraft carrier]], consisting of smaller attachments on each side, and one on the front of the main body. The main body and the two side attachments were covered with trees and buildings. The front had a spherical dome with [[World Pirates|the crew]]'s [[Jolly Roger]] on the front, and houses [[Firearm#Cannon|cannons]], including the ship's primary weapon, a giant cannon that, when combined with [[Byrnndi World]]'s [[Moa Moa no Mi|weapon-enhancing ability]], has the destructive potential to destroy an entire island. There were engines and aircraft runways on the back.  ==History== The Groseade was originally constructed as a means of avoiding battles with the [[Marines]] or [[pirate]]s, designed to submerge below the sea. It was constructed by the [[World Pirates]] during [[Byrnndi World]]'s [[Impel Down|imprisonment]]. It was eventually destroyed by the Marines.  ==Navigation== {{World Pirates Navibox}} {{Ships Navibox}} [[it:Groseade]] [[pl:Groseade]] [[Category:Non-Canon Destroyed Pirate Ships]]

fields.title: |multiimage=PC|imagetext=|opening=one}}  {{For|the Chinese mobile game|One Piece: Burning Will}}  '''''One Piece: Burning Blood''''' is a ''One Piece'' video game for the PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PS Vita, and PC which was released in Japan on April 21, 2016.  ==Gameplay== Similar to the ''Grand Battle!'' series, ''One Piece: Burning Blood'' is a 1-on-1 fighting game, featuring 3v3 melee style fights, where each player picks a team of 3 characters and 3 support characters. The player can switch between characters during battles and use partners for assist attacks, such as tagging in with the Unity Chain/Assist/Clash when certain special moves properly connect (which however, can be countered by the victim's opposing Unity-based mechanic and vice versa). However, teams can be constructed via 1, 2 or 3 members total, with varying combinations of both playable characters and supports being limited by a number (e.g. some teams may involve 1 character with a large-handful of supports, while some teams have the 3 character limit filled with only 1 or 2 supports).  However, the overall gameplay is much more akin to Spike Chunsoft's other fighting games, which primarily revolves around free-sandboxed-3D movement and basic attack strings allocated to a single button, along with specific button combinations which can allow access to special moves (holding down the special trigger button and combining it with three other basic buttons). Overall, the game somewhat follows the style of prior Spike Chunsoft-developed game, ''J-Stars Victory Vs.'' (which also features characters from ''One Piece''), albeit in a more restricted 1-on-1 scheme along with different features. Just like several fighting games and ''J-Stars Victory Vs.'' alike, it is a recent fighting game to introduce an "auto-combo-into special move finisher" mechanic in its basic attack chain. fields.status: Dissolved}}  The '''Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance''', originally '''Straw Hat-Heart Alliance''',{{Confirm}} was an alliance first formed between the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] and [[Heart Pirates]], but later on expanded to the [[Kouzuki Family]] and the [[Mink Tribe]]. Their goal was to take down [[Kaidou]] of the [[Four Emperors]],{{Qref|name=debut}} which succeeded during an [[Raid on Onigashima|all-out battle]]{{Qref|chap=1050|ep=1077|Kaidou and Big Mom's defeat causes an underwater volcano to erupt}} and put an end to Kaidou's [[New Onigashima Project|master plan]].{{Qref|name=project|chap=985|page=10-19|ep=993|ep2=994|Kaidou unveils the full details of the New Onigashima Project.}}  Upon the conclusion of their mission, the alliance officially disbanded with the groups going their separate ways: the two [[Worst Generation]] crews left Wano and continued their quests of finding the [[One Piece]]; the Kouzuki Family regained their [[shogun]]ate over the country after twenty years, with [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] as the new shogun; [[Inuarashi]] and [[Nekomamushi]] stay in Wano as vassals and pass their leadership of the Mink Tribe to [[Carrot]].  __TOC__ ==Members== {{SeeCat}} With the goal of reaching 5,000 strong,{{Qref|name=c920|chap=920|page=16|ep=911|Kin'emon states his goals for the alliance.}} the alliance managed to gather around 4,200 men.{{Qref|chap=959|page=2|ep=959|The alliance's number is given.}} Shortly before the raid on [[Onigashima]], [[Denjiro]] brought 1,200 men with him from the [[Flower Capital]], exceeding [[Kin'emon]]'s goal by around 400 men.{{Qref|chap=975|page=11-13|ep=979|Denjiro joins the alliance.}}  {{Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance Gallery}}  ===Organization=== ====Preparation Works==== Before the attack, the alliance divided its forces into teams.{{Qref|name=c954|chap=954|page=8|ep=955|The alliance's teams are shown.}}  *The {{Nihongo|'''Ship Repair Team'''|船整備班|Fune Seibi Han}} was responsible for repairing the [[ships

fields.funi eva: Cris George}}  '''Zepo''' was a {{W|polar bear}} [[mink]], [[Bepo]]'s older brother,{{Qref|name=sbs86|sbs=86|page=170}} and a member of the [[Nox Pirates]]. He was killed by [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] in [[Totto Land]] five years ago after he spun her Soul Pocus [[Roulette]].{{Qref|name=debut}}  ==Appearance== Zepo was a large bear mink with light-colored fur and a piece of dark hair on his head. He wore a pair of sunglasses, a button-down shirt, polka-dotted pants, and a large cape.{{Qref|name=debut}}  ==Abilities and Powers== As a [[mink]], Zepo was a natural-born warrior and could use [[Electro]].{{Qref|chap=808|page=9|ep=757|Monjii states that all minks are natural-born warriors.}}  ===Weapons=== Zepo wielded a cutlass, which he carried on his back. He has not been seen using it.{{Qref|name=debut}}  ==History== ===Biography=== Fifteen years ago, Zepo sailed with [[Pedro]] and [[Pekoms]] as part of the [[Nox Pirates]] in search of [[Poneglyph]]s. However, the crew grew injured and discouraged, and everyone except Zepo and Pedro withdrew from it.{{Qref|name=sbs86}}  [[File:Big Mom use Soul Pocus on Zepo.png|thumb|left|210px|Big Mom takes Zepo's lifespan.]]  Ten years after beginning their journey, Zepo and Pedro sailed into [[Totto Land]], where they reunited with Pekoms, who had joined the [[Big Mom Pirates]]. During their mission to steal [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]]'s [[Road Poneglyph]], Zepo and Pedro were defeated and captured. While facing judgement from Big Mom, Zepo spun her [[Roulette|roulette wheel]] to determine how he and Pedro would be punished, and landed on 100 years of their lifespan being removed. Big Mom removed Zepo's lifespan, but since he only had 30 years left to live, she took it all and he died.{{Qref|name=debut}}{{-}}  ==Trivia== *He shares the same voice actor with his younger brother, [[Bepo]]. *According to Bepo in ''[[One Piece novel Law]]'', Zepo's name means {{Nihongo|"handsome man"|イケメン|ikemen}} in the [[Mink Tribe]]'s language.{{

fields.bounty: At least {{B|s}}1,000,000{{Qref|special=marinebounties}}}}  {{For|the non-canon marine with a similar english name|Isoka}}  '''"Nailing" Isuka''' is a [[Marine Ranks#Ensign|Marine Ensign]] that confronted the [[Spade Pirates]] during their time of activity.  ==Appearance== [[File:Isuka Concept Art.png|thumb|left|210px|Isuka concept art.]]  Isuka is a young woman with short vermilion hair, brown eyes, a bandaid on her left cheek and a burn scar on the back of her hand. She typically wears a Marine uniform with a collared, buttoned shirt, a tie, brown gloves, shorts and heeled boots. On her shoulders she wears the standard Marine coat with {{Nihongo|"Justice"|正義|Seigi}} on the back.{{Qref|name=intro}}  When she was off-duty at [[Sabaody Archipelago]], she wore more casual tourist clothes.{{Qref|name=c3|novel=A1|nchap=3|Isuka meets Ace on the Sabaody Archipelago.}}  ==Personality== Isuka is a brave woman with a strong sense of justice, as she was willing to confront the Spade Pirates alone on their ship in order to arrest [[Portgas D. Ace]].{{Qref|name=intro}} She is very tenacious and dedicated, because she kept chasing Ace through the first half of the [[Grand Line]]. However, she can also be a little clumsy and naive, as she expected Ace to come out of his ship to confront her, not realizing he snuck away from the other side.{{Qref|name=c3}}  Isuka prioritizes saving fellow Marines and civilians over capturing criminals, and is horrified at Draw causing unnecessary casualties while fighting pirates. She also believes that those on the side of justice should not resort to taking hostages.{{Qref|name=c3}}  ==Relationships== ===Draw=== When Isuka was a young girl, [[Draw]] saved her from a fire that he started, which burned her village down and killed her parents. Unaware that he started the fire, Isuka looked up to him and joined the Marines so she could rescue people from pirates. fields.age: Over 30{{Qref|chap=424|ep=307|Mermaid tails split after turning 30.}}}}  '''Banshee'''{{Qref|name=opmag|magazine=2|Banshee and the rest of the Spade Pirates are named.}} is a [[Merfolk|mermaid]]{{Qref|novel=a2|nchap=5}} and was the only female member of the [[Spade Pirates]].{{Qref|name=debut}}  ==Appearance== She is a portly woman, wearing a short sleeved blouse and dark pants with light polka dots on them. She also wears dark colored heels and is seen holding a flintock. She has long, wavy light colored hair with a dark bandanna that has light colored polka dots and she wears dark lipstick.{{Qref|name=opmag}}  Banshee is easily able to pass as human, as her tail fin forked when she was 30, allowing her to wear human clothes.  ==Personality== Banshee cares greatly about her captain, [[Portgas D. Ace]], since she was willing to defend him from [[Edward Newgate]].{{Qref|name=debut}} Banshee can also be somewhat disrespectful, laughing at Deuce's adventure diary despite the fact that it is his main aspiration of their travels.{{Qref|name=a1|novel=a1|nchap=2|Banshee and her crew mates fight Isuka and reach Sabaody Archipelago.}}  ==Relationships== ===Portgas D. Ace=== Like the rest of the Spade Pirates, Banshee cares greatly for her captain, defending him from an [[Four Emperors|Emperor]]. However, she was not seen during the [[Summit War of Marineford]].  ===Masked Deuce=== Most of the Spade Pirates' crew members (excluding [[Skull]], [[Mihar]], and [[Kotatsu]]) read and laughed at Deuce's poor writing in his adventure diary. Because of this, their names were excluded from the diary.{{Qref|name=a1}}  ==Abilities and Powers== Since the [[Spade Pirates]] did not have a [[cook]], Banshee was the one who prepared their meals.{{Qref|novel=a2}}  Banshee's fighting abilities are unknown, but she and her crew were easily defeated by Newgate.{{Qref|name=debut}}  As a mermaid, Banshee has several abilities unique to her race.
